rows.context_and_review_note: Exact-base ClassicPaintActivity.kt:854 uses setScale(-1f,1f), reversing x coordinates. Corrected truncated snql to snqlb (turn/flip something over), retaining left/right endpoints so the reflection is not mistaken for a rotation or reflection about the horizontal axis. Generic verb plus endpoints is a contextual UI translation, not a claim of a standardized mathematical reflection term.

Exact-base ClassicPaintActivity.kt:855 uses setScale(1f,-1f), reversing y coordinates. Corrected snql to snqlb consistently; top/bottom remains explicit. aflla/adda identifies the endpoints exchanged and does not imply reversing left/right or applying a half-turn.

Exact-base ClassicPaintActivity.kt:856 uses setRotate(90f), then fits the viewport. Corrected sutl to ssutl, with doubled initial s, consistent with the attested Moroccan rotate/turn verb. Rightward quarter-turn conveys clockwise in the image plane; no translation or counterclockwise movement is claimed. Preserved literal 90°.

Exact-base ClassicPaintActivity.kt:857 uses setRotate(180f). Corrected sutl to ssutl. Preserved literal 180° and did not add a direction, since clockwise and counterclockwise half-turns produce the same result.

Exact-base EditGroup.TRANSFORM maps command indices 6,7,8,9 to the two reflections and two rotations. Corrected both verbs to match the command labels exactly. Imperative wording is used as the paired-action group label, not as a claim that both actions execute together.
